source: Rooney et al. 2026, Global Ecology and Biogeography e70229, DOI 10.1111/geb.70229
verbatim_summary: The study authors modified the Start_Date and End_Date values in the deployment metadata using the dates of the first and last photographic images from the sequence file; camera trap-nights also use first/last image times.
prior_assumption_rejected: Nominal field dictionary labels (camera placed / retrieved) do not imply the distributed curated date values were untouched by image observations.
next_steps: Require separate genuine hardware deployment records or prospectively collected logs, independent of animal detection records; if unavailable stop future-refit probability primary endpoint for this source.
